Health.md is a health data export app. Every permission below maps directly to data read from Health Connect and exported only to the destination you choose. Folder exports stay in local or provider-backed storage. If you explicitly select API Endpoint, records are sent directly to the HTTP or HTTPS URL you configure; HTTP is not encrypted in transit. If you explicitly connect a paired Direct CLI, records are sent through an authenticated encrypted connection to that computer. Personal Health Record resources are exported only when you select that metric and grant the related permissions. History access is used for large manual exports. Background access is used only when you enable scheduled exports.

Direct CLI exports occur only after you explicitly pair and connect to your computer. Health records are sent through an authenticated encrypted connection, retained privately for resumable transfer for at most seven days, and deleted sooner when you cancel or forget the pairing.

Open Samsung Health and enable sharing with Health Connect. Samsung\'s direct Health Data SDK can be added later if partner-approved data is needed outside Health Connect.
Huawei support requires HMS Health Kit app registration and an HMS-enabled build. This catalog keeps Huawei visible without adding HMS dependencies to the Play build.
Fitbit trackers, Pixel Watch Fitbit data, sleep, activity, heart.
Direct Fitbit import uses the Fitbit Web API with OAuth scopes and refresh tokens. Until app credentials are configured, export Fitbit data through Health Connect where available.
Garmin watches, training, activity, sleep, body battery-style metrics.
Garmin production imports require Garmin Health API partner approval and usually a backend/webhook sync path. Health.md excludes Google Fit fallbacks by design.
Withings scales, watches, blood pressure, sleep mats.
Direct Withings import uses OAuth 2.0 and the Withings public API. Configure client credentials before enabling live cloud reads.
Oura Ring sleep, readiness, activity, heart rate, HRV.
Direct Oura import uses the Oura Cloud API with OAuth 2.0. Configure client credentials before enabling live cloud reads.
Polar training, heart-rate devices, sleep/activity via AccessLink.
Historical Polar import should use Polar AccessLink OAuth. BLE sensor support is a separate future live-session feature, not a replacement for history export.
WHOOP recovery, strain, sleep, workouts, physiology.
Direct WHOOP import uses the WHOOP API with OAuth scopes for cycles, recovery, sleep, workouts, and profile data.
